atomicity.reason: One obligation - monotonic non-increase of the reported figure; the discard sentence is the same obligation expressed as its mechanism.

comprehensibility.reason: Self-contained - it states the reported quantity, its unit and the monotonic rule with its mechanism.

feasibility.reason: Implementable as a discard rule, but permanently discarding higher measurements means a repaired or recalibrated pack can never report its true capacity; and because no accuracy bound is stated anywhere, a constant figure would conform while telling the fleet operator nothing.
feasibility.suggestion: Pair the monotonic rule with an accuracy bound on the reported capacity (against a bench full-discharge reference) and a defined service reset for pack repairs.

parent_fit.reason: Directly delivers the parent story's observable that the fleet report shows a remaining-capacity figure that only decreases over the life of the pack.

unambiguity.reason: Clear for a pack in continuous service but silent on legitimate increases - module replacement or a service recalibration - so it is open whether the never-increase rule survives a repair or applies only to one pack configuration.
unambiguity.suggestion: State the exceptions explicitly, e.g. the reported value may be reset on a documented pack repair, and scope the monotonic rule to an unchanged pack configuration.

verifiability.reason: Directly checkable against a sequence of reported values: any increase between successive values is a failure.

summary: Faithful to the parent's monotonic-capacity observable, but the never-increase rule has no exception for a repaired pack and the requirement sets no accuracy bound at all, so a constant reported value would satisfy it.
